notes: Synthetic follower tables with positive, negative and high-word-dirty indices; matching and other grid markers, inactive and active rows, states 0, 1, 2 and 0xff, levels around 0x1b, the alternate grid mode on and off, immediate dwords 0, 1, 0xff and 0x100 (only the low byte counts), and signed reference clocks. The advance 0x37fe4 (with its double and ret 8), follower update 0x381a0, accept tests 0x37e60/0x37d3c (AL 0, 1, 0x80), start 0x37934 and hook 0x54b9c are loggers; the AX-only callees log AX.
